ios.desc:
Greenlight makes it easier to turn “we should do something” into an actual plan.

See when friends are available, coordinate in groups, chat one-to-one or together, and create events without losing the details across different apps. Share messages, reactions, polls, voice notes, photos, videos, and GIFs. Invite the right people, track who is going, and keep event conversations connected to the plan.

Availability at a glance

Go green when you are free and let your groups know. Nudge friends when it is time to make something happen.

Chats that stay organized

Keep direct and group conversations together, reply to messages, react, create polls, and find shared media.

Events with the context included

Create events, invite friends, manage attendance, discuss details, and optionally add plans to your device calendar.

Safety and control

Mute conversations, report users or individual messages, event posts, and comments, and block people when needed.

Greenlight does not contain third-party advertising and does not sell your personal data.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app for initiating social activity

quotes.text:
Greenlight social.
It's basically an app for saying "I'm ready" or "Let's do x...".

Background is that my friend group plays video games, grabs beer or whatever - and a lot of the communication revolves around logistics. This app lowered the threshold for initiating. We create a group per activity, and "going green" means you're ready. The other group members get a push notification "Paul is greenlit!" and the title of the group is "Play Dota 2" or "Beer at local pub". Super simple concept, but it actually works.

TLDR; I made an app that let's you press a button instead of writing the typical "Does anyone want to join x activity?"

https://apps.apple.com/no/app/greenlight-squads/id6757295236
